exemplar.noncompliant:
uid = request.args.get('id')
q = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id={uid}"
cur.execute(q)
exemplar.compliant:
q = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?"
cur.execute(q, (request.args.get('id'),))
exemplar.explanation: use a parameterized query; pass the value as a bound parameter, never string-built into the SQL
